notes.title: Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate is OUT NOW
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/4a4541d5c11d0f52218fad6e8371aae572b16eb2.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

[h1]Use magic spells and military surplus explosives to topple an evil crime syndicate hidden beneath a prestigious wizarding school. Learn spells, engage in espionage, and spread lore-unfriendly chaos. [/h1]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/8a10814a7cc6b72e23f82b9f42a3b57ac9509b37.gif[/img]

[u]Secret Agent Wizard Boy and the International Crime Syndicate[/u] is a comedic sandbox with a complete lack of safety nets or boundaries.  Players are free to indulge in the full abject chaos of untethered physics simulations and uncontainable emergent gameplay, using a toolkit of magical spells and items to solve problems in ways we cannot hope to balance against.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/41808760a60aae8aeb109cad8ea3bb4fddf828b1.gif[/img]

Wizard Boy can also team up with other Wizard Boys in cooperative(?) multiplayer to explore (blow up) the castle together and thwart the evil International crime syndicate S.P.I.D.E.R once and for all!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/936ff34a9038dfe99745f535206b311537012ad3.gif[/img]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*] A multitude of spells to learn and inflict on others
[*] Chaotic, barely contained physics-based mayhem
[*] Open-ended goals to accomplish (or ignore) however you see fit
[*] Online co-op, although actual cooperation is unlikely
[*] Retro-themed third person action, straight from the days of Unreal Engine 1
[*] Landmines and other non-magical ordnance
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3111080/Secret_Agent_Wizard_Boy_and_the_International_Crime_Syndicate/

notes.title: Butcher's Creek is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/a2a280c65d75ca9252fb955192680d7c1f05a54b.jpg[/img]

A troubled loner with a hunger for cinematic gore finds himself on the other side of the camera when rumors of authentic snuff videotapes lead him to an abandoned cabin near Butcher's Creek, Pennsylvania. What starts as illicit urban exploration becomes a fight for survival when he's captured by a gang of sadistic killers. Now his only option is to pick up a box cutter, a hammer, a pickaxe, or whatever else is at hand, and unleash a little video violence of his own.

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Use hammers, axes, pipes, 2x4s, box cutters, and more to brutalize anything that stands between you and freedom

[*]When all else fails, the level itself can be a weapon. Kick props into enemies, or enemies into environment hazards.

[*]Photograph gruesome murder scenes to fulfill your dark desires and regain lost health

[*]Explore decaying farmhouses, collapsing factories, and seedy strip clubs in a forgotten corner of the Appalachian Forest

[*]Experience a unique aesthetic combining the gritty shot-on-video look of found footage with the photosourced visual style of Source Engine games

[*]Learn more about the bizarre nightmare world introduced in Squirrel Stapler and The Pony Factory
[/list]

https://youtu.be/3TLL1g8Z8Y0?si=jCY8kkxFaEhi3XpY
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512560/Butchers_Creek/

notes.title: The Pony Factory is out now!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536530/The_Pony_Factory/
Winston arrived at a solution to the moral decay of his town.

He called out to hell, and hell answered. The human body could, hell promised, be twisted and stretched into a kinder, more equine shape. Winston's town, now filled with ignorant hate-mongers, could instead be filled with magical ponies, if he could provide a factory in which to make them. Winston thought they would be beautiful, gentle, and good.

[i][b]Hell had other plans...[/b][/i]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/f5b229a724a8109c1102ffd3ab63b19ca8c0ae9d.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2536530/The_Pony_Factory/]The Pony Factory[/url] is a short action/horror game inspired by Doom 3, with a darkly comedic story, striking black and white visual style, and visceral FPS gameplay. This is an updated standalone release of the original game, which was created in 7 days as part of the Dread X Collection 1.

[h2]FEATURES[/h2]
[list]
[*]Meaty FPS combat against highly agile foes who will attempt to evade and flank you.
[*]Darkness is your enemy!  Use muzzle flashes, sparks, sound, and other clues to track foes during combat.
[*]High contrast black and white aesthetic inspired by early 1950's science fiction films.
[*]A short minimalist campaign that can be completed in about 30 minutes.
[*]Numerous improvements from the original release, including many new quality of life features, balance and game feel improvements, new story and gameplay content, full gamepad support, and of course bugfixes!
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/95215f003c102674f4b81e4e08fa0ab9bbb4d4dc.png[/img]

My brother [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/szymanski]John Szymanski[/url] (director of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1574260/My_Friendly_Neighborhood/]My Friendly Neighborhood[/url]) assisted with this version and will be receiving half of the royalties in an effort to provide him with enough income to continue game development until he begins receiving money from MFN.

John also released his own game today: a tense puzzle/horror game called Exiled:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2741620/Exiled/

[h1]Both games can be [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37884/The_Pony_Factory__Exiled/]purchased as a bundle together[/url] too![/h1]

notes.title: God is coming, September 15th...
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/44a02a67259b893e9cfd71b07904bacfa56d9b89.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535830/Squirrel_Stapler/

[h1][u]IT IS TIME TO HUNT THE SQUIRRELS...[/u][/h1]
A lonely man living in a remote cabin wakes up one day and realizes his beloved--a dismembered corpse nailed to the cabin wall--has been made ugly and rotten by the flies that swarm her. He wishes she were beautiful, like the squirrels of the wood. And so he sets out to hunt the squirrels of the wood, so that he might staple them to her and make her beautiful again.

Originally created as part of The Dread X Collection II, Squirrel Stapler is a horror hunting simulator that satirizes low budget edutainment games with pitch black humor and panic-inducing absurdist horror, and a new and improved standalone version is coming [u][b]September 15th![/b][/u]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/34055240/83f766b4a2e6747a0eaf84e28965d8e7aa4f2653.png[/img]

[h1][u]IN SQUIRREL STAPLER YOU CAN...[/u][/h1]
[list]
[*]Hunt squirrels! Move quietly, hide in bushes, stay low, and pick the right time to pull the trigger!
[*]Lure even bigger squirrels with a squirrel call!
[*]Be wary of larger creatures and vengeful ghosts! You aren't the only alpha predator in the forest!
[*]Freely explore a large nonlinear map littered with educational squirrel facts and more!
[*]Meet god! 
[/list]

[i][u][b]For more information, check out the Steam page![/b][/u][/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535830/Squirrel_Stapler/

notes.title: Chop Goblins is out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34055240/fb9d499a41ce38090225d570be2e54d4612d7a07.png[/img]

You thought it would be fun to break into a nearby museum and root through the artifacts stored there. Little did you know that a dusty chest in the basement imprisoned the evil [b]CHOP GOBLINS[/b].

Now they're loose, wrecking bladed havok on the world once again. It's up to you to chase them through the city and across space and time, in a bespoke FPS campaign spanning the modern day, 1800's Transylvania, ancient Greece, and the not too distant future.

[u]And you can finish it in about 30 minutes![/u]

[url=]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1935660/Chop_Goblins/[/url]

Chop Goblins is a "microshooter": An FPS designed to be completed in a single sitting, without sacrificing depth, variety, or creativity in its gameplay and level design. It's a game you can play for less than an hour, or replay for many hours. Need something to distract you from work, boredom, or grinding in other games? Take a Chop Goblins Break, with a fun and satisfying FPS campaign that only takes one sitting to fully experience.

notes.title: Iron Lung is OUT NOW
notes.content:
Pilot a tiny submarine through an ocean of blood on an alien moon in [u][b]Iron Lung[/b][/u], a short dread-driven underwater (underblood?) horror game

[h1]OUT NOW[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1846170/Iron_Lung/

Set entirely within a claustrophobic one-man submarine nicknamed the "Iron Lung," you must blindly navigate an ocean of blood to take photographs of key locations, and hope whatever lives below doesn't find you.
There is only a single porthole on the sub, and it needs to be closed due to depth pressure, so you have to navigate purely via an incomplete map, proximity sensors, sound, and a primitive external camera which can be used to take the pictures you need to complete your mission, or to get a grainy low resolution visual of what's happening outside.

Success will require resourcefulness and patience.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34055240/7bbf04170ab9a9b3b990f9d15af65a7c002ae7f1.png[/img]

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[list]
[*]Experimental minimalist gameplay, where your senses are limited and anything could be lurking around you
[*]Glimpse your surroundings through the lens of a grainy still camera and navigate using an incomplete satellite map and proximity sensors
[*]Horror based around building dread and paranoia
[*]Original soundtrack inspired by the work of Aubrey Hodges (Doom 64)
[*]A short experience intended to be finished in under an hour
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34055240/ff693bc80fa81dae5d2f799d259307870cce45c6.png[/img]

Soundtrack also available at https://davidszymanski.bandcamp.com/album/iron-lung-ost

notes.title: Fingerbones is open source!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9605186/9cd7342d4eef3ef4f3bbfb35beab86d774cfd71d.jpg[/img]

Fingerbones is now open source under "The Unlicense!"  Which means you're free to take the code and basically do whatever you want with it.  Credit is appreciated but not necessary.

The source can be downloaded here: [url=https://gitlab.com/jefequeso/fingerbones]https://gitlab.com/jefequeso/fingerbones[/url]

Fingerbones was a huge experiment for me.  It was the project I did to learn Unity, it was the first thing I ever made in true 3d space, and it was the first time I'd released something serious, philosophical, and narrative-focused rather than gameplay-focused.  So naturally there were a few elements that worked and a lot of elements that didn't quite work.  While I'm still proud of some parts of Fingerbones, I no longer feel that it positively represents me as a developer, or that it's something I'd ever want to return to.  So I thought it would be appropriate to release it to whatever fans it might have, in case any of you want to do something with it.

And if you have any interest in what I've done since, be sure to check out my retro FPS DUSK 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/519860/DUSK/

And you can find my post-Fingerbones horror games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/davidszymanski]on my creator page[/url]

I also want to take the opportunity to thank everyone.  Fingerbones started my car[img][/img]eer as a developer, and I'm eternally grateful to everyone who gave the game a chance and spread the word.  I wouldn't be here without you, and releasing my creation back into the wild is the least I can do as thanks.

Have fun!

- David

notes.title: 'The Grandfather' has been released
notes.content:
The collab project between MPR Art Hallucinations and I--The Grandfather--has been released on Steam:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/433750/

The Grandfather is a strange point and click adventure inspired by surrealist films such as David Lynch's Eraserhead.  It follows the story of an old man who is tormented by the coldness of his wife, and wakes up one night to find that his arms, legs, and torso are missing, leaving him a disembodied floating head.

Keep in mind that The Grandfather was designed/directed by MPR Art Hallucinations (creator of The Lady) and simply programmed by me.  So expect a much different (much more surreal) experience than you get in my solo horror games.

notes.title: Looking for Feedback
notes.content:
Since I'm taking a more "relaxed" approach to game development for now, I thought it would be a good time to improve some areas I might be weak in.  So I'd like feedback from anyone and everyone on about where you think my writing could improve.  I'd like to hear issues relating to characters, story, prose, or narrative that you have with any of my games.  Please leave feedback at http://ironsnowflakes.blogspot.com/2015/12/critique-my-writing.html (you do not need an account to leave a comment).

Only thing I ask is that your feedback is CONSTRUCTIVE.  This is not the place to vent your anger at me or my games.  That's what Steam reviews are for, it seems.

notes.title: My latest horror game, A Wolf in Autumn, has been released!
notes.content:
My latest horror game, A Wolf in Autumn, has been released on Steam!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/395270/

After escaping from a locked shed, a young girl finds herself in the middle of an idyllic autumn forest. At first her surroundings seem peaceful, and she's comforted by her mother's voice coming through a strange tin device. But gradually, things begin to turn disturbing and sinister. And the distant howling of wolves begins to move closer...

A Wolf in Autumn is a dark, surreal psychological horror game.  It focuses on creating a short engaging horror experience that relies on narrative, pacing, context, and atmosphere rather than jump scares.

notes.title: IndieGoGo Campaign for The Grandfather is live!
notes.content:
View “The Grandfather” IndieGoGo campaign and download the Demo here: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/the-grandfather--2/x/5229043#/

The upcoming atmospheric point & click horror/puzzle game “The Grandfather” has launched an IndieGoGo campaign. The campaign features some one of a kind and limited perks, including the Autoharp that the soundtrack was recorded on, and a special edition of the game with 20 wallpapers and two different versions of the unique soundtrack. 

“The Grandfather” is collaboration from the creator of “Fingerbones” and the creator of “The Lady”; both devs thrive at creating hauntingly rich atmospheres with a mix of visuals, audio, and a different approach to storytelling. The game tells its story through the use of comic book pages and narration/voice acting. The Grandfather features all hand drawn art by amazing comic book artist SaintYak http://saintyak.deviantart.com/gallery/  , and a procedural soundtrack composed by Michael Patrick Rogers https://soundcloud.com/mprart-1 , which is created by the user as they play the game.

notes.title: "The Grandfather" demo released.
notes.content:
The DEMO for "The Grandfather" (A collab between me and MPR Art Hallucinations) is now available for download at the following places (PC & MAC)

 

itchio http://mpr-art-hallucinations.itch.io/thegrandfatherdemo

 
IndieDB http://www.indiedb.com/games/the-grandfather/downloads

 

Steam Coming later this week

 

"The Grandfather" is a collaboration from the creators of "The Lady" and "Fingerbones"

"The Grandfather" is a unique Story Driven Point and Click puzzle/horror Game, presented in a pop-up storybook, comic book art style, with narration by a voice actress. The Game tells the tale of an old man who is tormented by the coldness of his wife. The Grandfather is a combination of exploration and point and click elements, and features a procedural soundtrack that is created by the user as they play the game.

 

This is a Pre-Alpha DEMO and does not fully represent the finished game, an IndieGoGo campaign launches on October 3rd!!

 

Be sure to follow "The Grandfather" on Twitter @GrandfatherGame for updates on the development of the game. "The Grandfather" is expected to release in spring 2016 on PC/MAC and shortly after on PS4.

notes.title: 'The Grandfather': Demo Coming Soon + 'A Wolf in Autumn': Game Coming Soon
notes.content:
First, a big thanks to everyone who downloaded and played Fingerbones!  I'm really happy so many people have liked it, and found it affecting.

Second, I wanted to let you know about an upcoming game that I'm working on with MPR Art Hallucinations, developer of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/341060]The Lady[/url].  The game is primarily his project, but I'm doing programming and assisting with the design.  It follows an old man who is emotionally tormented by his heartless wife, and wakes up one night to find himself a floating head, with his arms, legs, and torso missing.

A short demo will be coming some time in September, and an IndieGoGo campaign to fund the whole project will be launching in October.

If you'd like to learn more about The Grandfather, you can check out the devblog at [url]=http://www.mprart.net/the-grandfather-dev-blog/[/url] and follow development on Twitter at [url]https://twitter.com/GrandfatherGame[/url]

Third, my next solo project, 'A Wolf in Autumn,' is well along its way, and I expect to release it some time in October.  If you'd like to know more about the game, you can view some rather pretty screenshots and the announcement trailer at [url]http://ironsnowflakes.blogspot.com/p/current-project.html[/url] if you'd like to check them out.

I suppose I should also remind you guys again that while Fingerbones was recently released on Steam, it's actually over a year old and I've released two other horror games since then.  Visit [url]http://ironsnowflakes.blogspot.com/[/url]

Whew, that was a lot of stuff.
